_about: Export: the video preview (notes/export-design/VIDEO-PREVIEW.md, work/xvv, 2026-10-24). With Format = Video the dialog plays the video as it will be saved, with play/pause, a scrubber and the time. id -> {en, ru, note}. Russian follows notes/i18n/GLOSSARY.md (кадр; воспроизвести / пауза; отрисовка; «вы», imperative plural, a button name in «»). 'Play' and 'Pause' reuse the app's strings. Read by tools/make_ru_table.py (v15-*.json).

vpv.hint.note: The stage's top line with Format = Video: the video's size, frame rate and whole length. Replaces '... · this frame: t = {t}' (the bar under the picture now gives t).

vpv.canvas.en: The video, as it will be saved
vpv.canvas.ru: Видео в том виде, в каком оно будет сохранено
vpv.canvas.note: aria-label of the playing preview (role img).

vpv.seek.note: aria-label of the scrubber (a range over the video's frames).

vpv.time.note: The time under the preview: where the playhead is / the whole video, in seconds (one decimal).

vpv.valuetext.note: aria-valuetext of the scrubber: the time and the deformation's t of the frame in view.

vpv.filling.note: The note under the preview while its frames are being drawn (by tens of per cent).

vpv.exact.en: Preview: the frames of the video itself
vpv.exact.note: Every frame drawn, kept at the video's own size.

vpv.scaled.en: Preview: the frames of the video itself, scaled to fit here (the video is {w} × {h})
vpv.scaled.ru: Предпросмотр: кадры самого видео, уменьшенные под это окно (само видео — %{w} × %{h})
vpv.scaled.note: Every frame drawn, kept as it is: each is the video's exact frame, scaled down once to the size the dialog shows it at (device pixels). {w} × {h} is the video's own size, so nobody takes the preview's softness for the video's (review vp-1).

vpv.compressed.en: Preview: the frames of the video itself, lightly compressed
vpv.compressed.ru: Предпросмотр: кадры самого видео, слегка сжатые
vpv.compressed.note: A long timeline: each frame is kept at full size but compressed (WebP or JPEG, quality 0.92) so the frames fit in memory (review vp-1).

vpv.scaledCompressed.en: Preview: the frames of the video itself, scaled to fit here and lightly compressed (the video is {w} × {h})
vpv.scaledCompressed.ru: Предпросмотр: кадры самого видео, уменьшенные под это окно и слегка сжатые (само видео — %{w} × %{h})
vpv.scaledCompressed.note: Both: scaled to the size shown (device pixels) and compressed to fit in memory; {w} × {h} is the video's own size (review vp-1).

vpv.reduced.en: Paused: reduced motion is on. Press Play to watch.
vpv.reduced.ru: Пауза: включено уменьшение движения. Нажмите «Воспроизвести», чтобы посмотреть.
vpv.reduced.note: prefers-reduced-motion: the preview waits on the poster frame. «Воспроизвести» is the button's own label (the app's 'Play').
